name: Moc Chau
provinceNote: Sơn La province. The 2026 wards are phường Mộc Châu and phường Thảo Nguyên. Older listings use huyện Mộc Châu and the farm-town name.
dotReason: Worth a special trip in this corridor
summary: A highland plateau in Son La province, covered in tea hills and pasture, with plum blossom in the cold months. Walk the heart-shaped tea hills, see Dai Yem waterfall and the glass Bach Long bridge, and drink fresh milk and yogurt from the farms. One or two nights suits families and photographers.
fee: Plateau size and height: about 80 km by 25 km and over 1,000 m; 1,050 m; average 1,150–1,300 m, with limestone from 1,050 m; about 1,500 m. Dai Yem: drop over 100 m; first fall about 70 m in three tiers, a first tier about 40 m deep, about 70 m wide, and about 50 m high; the two falls about 200 m apart and also 150 m apart. Water fullest April to September, a sheet about 70 m wide. First fall’s lip May to September. Second fall April to September. Chieng Khoa has no published height and no published fee. Dai Yem fee and hours: Check on arrival. Bat Cave, also Son Moc Huong: over 7,000 square meters, 100 m high, 930 m long, and 240 steps; also about 240 steps, an entrance about 100 m above the road, about 6,915 square meters, a highest point about 20 m, a length about 80 m, and a width about 25 m. Dairy gate: 08:00–18:00, 20,000 VND and 10,000 VND. Check the gate on arrival. Pha Luong: 2,000 m and nearly 2,000 m. Tea ground: about 3,000 ha and more than 3,000 ha. A 2019 line said the hills charged no ticket. That is not a 2026 fee. Check on arrival. Moc Suong fee: Check on arrival. Bach Long ordinary hours and fee: Check on arrival. Ban Ang horseback fee: Check on arrival. Ban Ang lake 5 ha. Night-market clock and stall price: Check on arrival. Walking-street closing hour: Check on arrival. Next blossom week after a best day on 8 Jan 2026 and an opening on 17 Jan 2026: Check on arrival. Temperature: annual average about 21ºC, and a summer average of 20ºC.
getThere: About 200 km from Hanoi on National Highway 6, and also 198 km. Mai Chau is about 70 km before the plateau, of which about 60 km is the pass. Minutes on the Mai Chau leg: Check on arrival. Bus from My Dinh, as of 16 Oct 2026: average 4 hours 10 minutes and about 40 services a day; also about 4 to 4 hours 30 minutes by bus, a car about 4 hours 30 minutes to 5 hours, a motorbike about 5 hours, operator blocks of 3 hours 30 minutes and 4 hours 15 minutes, and about 4 to 5 hours. Fares 280,000 VND and 250,000 VND. A road-authority duration: Check on arrival. An expressway is described as newly operational, with no duration. An 8 Oct 2026 inspection still had the Hoa Binh–Moc Chau expressway under construction, at about 16.73 percent of contract value, with a contract opening in the first quarter of 2028. The road you can use is National Highway 6. No commercial flight into Moc Chau or Na San, and no named rail station. Noi Bai is the airport. National Highway 43 leaves Highway 6 for Dai Yem, Ban Ang, and Long Sap. The Laos border on that road is 32 km and also 33 km. Kilometers west toward Son La and Dien Bien Phu: Check on arrival. A local bus, a taxi fare, or a ride-hailing map on the plateau: Check on arrival.
bestMonths: April to September for the falls; blossom weeks move
seoTitle: Moc Chau travel guide — tea hills, plum blossom, dairy
seoDescription: Tea rows after the Highway 6 pass, plum blossom in the cold weeks, and a morning cup from the dairy. This is not Mai Chau’s rice valley.
intro: You come over the pass and the land opens into tea rows, pasture, and, in the cold weeks, white plum blossom on a valley. Stay if that morning is the trip. Sleep in Mai Chau if you wanted the rice valley before the pass. Do not book Son La city when the plateau night is the point.

The bed is a small hotel or homestay in the farm town, or a Thai stilt house at Ban Ang, about 2 km south on National Highway 43, under the pine. No hotel brand is a pick. After dark the walk is the farm-town walking street and night market around the Pha Luong light park, a ground of more than 2 ha with nearly 60 stalls. Festival nights move to Square 08-5 in phường Mộc Châu. Weekends are the fuller nights.

Give the morning to the tea rows or the dairy pasture, then Dai Yem or Na Ka depending on the month. Na Ka is the blossom and harvest valley. The dairy stop is the morning cup. The published heights for Dai Yem sit together on the fee line: over 100 m, and a first fall of about 70 m.

Bat Cave, also called Son Moc Huong, is the roadside cave on the way across the plateau. Pha Luong is the high point at 2,000 m, and also nearly 2,000 m. The heart-shaped tea hills are at Tan Lap. Do not sit on the bushes.
gettingAround: The usual start is Hanoi, and the road is National Highway 6. Mai Chau is the valley before the pass. Bicycle and motorbike rentals are offered for the tea hills.

A rental car, a bus from My Dinh, or a motorbike are the ways up. No commercial flight lands at Moc Chau or Na San, and no rail station is named. Noi Bai in Hanoi is the airport travelers use. The Hoa Binh–Moc Chau expressway was still being built on an 8 Oct 2026 inspection.

On the plateau, National Highway 6 is the spine. National Highway 43 leaves it for Dai Yem, Ban Ang, and Long Sap, and continues to the Laos border. Highway 6 continues west toward Son La city and Dien Bien Phu.

stayAreas.name: Farm town
stayAreas.summary: Small hotels and homestays on the plateau strip. This is the bed, the morning yogurt, and the night-market walk. The old farm-town name and the 2026 ward names are one base.

stayAreas.name: Ban Ang
stayAreas.summary: Thai stilt houses about 2 km south of the farm town on National Highway 43, under the pine, with a 5 ha lake. Horseback is offered.

eat: The morning cup is cold yogurt or fresh milk in the farm town. Three 3-star cups are named: plain yogurt, black sticky-rice yogurt, and passion-fruit yogurt.

At Ban Ang the table includes bamboo sticky rice, pa pỉnh tộp, smoked meat, bê chao, love sticky rice, leaf-yeast wine, bamboo-tube fish, forest greens, and jar wine from a gourd. The calf is also called flash-fried veal, and the fish a charcoal grill.

Also named: bánh dày, thắng cố, hearth-smoked buffalo, five-colour sticky rice, canh bon, soured meat, and rượu hoẵng. The night market, more than 2 ha around the Pha Luong light park, serves dried buffalo and hearth sausage. Weekends are fuller.
interestsBody: Tea-hill contours are the picture of the plateau. Dai Yem and the Bach Long bridge are the other walks.
Plum valleys, the dairy herd, Ban Ang’s pine, and the Bat Cave are part of the same plateau day. Na Ka is the blossom and harvest valley. The dairy stop is the morning pasture.

body: Cơm lam at Ban Ang is sticky rice cooked in a bamboo tube. Eat it from the tube. Yogurt, fresh milk, milk cake, hau plum, plateau tea, and the Hmong, Thai, and Dao plates are the other names. The night market is a ground of more than 2 ha around the Pha Luong light park, with nearly 60 stalls. Weekends are fuller.

interestGroups.summary: A morning in the rows, when the picture you came for is the plateau rather than a rice valley.

cards.title: Tea-hill contours
cards.summary: Walk the contour rows at Tan Lap. The tea ground is about 3,000 ha, and also more than 3,000 ha. Do not sit on the bushes.

body: The heart-shaped hills are at Tan Lap, reached from the farm town. At least three hills are named. The turns are old.
Moc Suong is the processing visit beside those hills: watch the leaf and an old tea ceremony.

interestGroups.title: Limestone falls
interestGroups.summary: Dai Yem, the two drops in the limestone.

cards.title: Limestone falls
cards.summary: Dai Yem is the fall you hear before you see it. Every published height is on the fee line.

body: The drop is over 100 m, and the first fall is also about 70 m in three tiers, with a first tier about 40 m deep, about 70 m wide, and about 50 m high. The two falls are about 200 m apart, and also 150 m apart.

The water is fullest from April to September, a sheet about 70 m wide. The first fall’s lip is also given as May to September, and the second as April to September. Chieng Khoa is named beside Dai Yem.

interestGroups.summary: The glass span in the hills.

cards.title: Bach Long bridge
cards.summary: A park called Moc Chau Island, reached across Bach Long bridge. No length is published.

body: The January 2026 flower program used the site for adventure sports and a market-style space.
It is a built park beside the farms. It is not the tea picture, and it is not a sea island.

blocks.heading: Moc Chau night market
paragraphs: The night market wraps the farm-town walking street around the Pha Luong light park. The ground is more than 2 ha, with nearly 60 stalls split into a trade side and a food side. Weekends are the fuller nights. The food side serves dried buffalo and hearth sausage with a cup of strong wine.

cards.title: Night market
cards.summary: Nearly 60 stalls around the Pha Luong light park, trade on one side and food on the other.

faqs.a: Mai Chau is the rice valley on National Highway 6 before the pass. Moc Chau is the tea plateau after it, with plum blossom in the cold weeks and a dairy morning.

faqs.q: How long is the bus from Hanoi?
faqs.a: As of 16 Oct 2026, an average of 4 hours 10 minutes, a range of about 4 to 4 hours 30 minutes, and operator blocks of 3 hours 30 minutes and 4 hours 15 minutes. A car is about 4 hours 30 minutes to 5 hours, a motorbike about 5 hours, and another reading is about 4 to 5 hours. About 40 services a day leave My Dinh. Fares are 280,000 VND and 250,000 VND. The road is about 200 km, and also 198 km.

season.label: Cold dry winter, wet summer
season.note: Winter is cold and dry and summer is rainy, with no typhoons. The average annual temperature is about 21ºC, and a summer average of 20ºC is also given. Dai Yem is fullest from April to September. The first fall’s lip is also May to September, and the second fall April to September. Plum blossom was at its best on 8 Jan 2026, and the flower program opened on 17 Jan 2026. The next blossom week moves. Winter mornings and evenings are foggy on this alignment.
